pins.definition: A knitted piece of clothing with long sleeves that covers the upper part of the body and has no buttons down the front.
A warm, knitted garment for the upper body that is pulled over the head.
A warm knitted piece of clothing with long sleeves, worn on the upper body.

situation: A man stands in an autumn doorway pulling a thick wool garment over his head before stepping outside.
subject: the knitted top
brief: A man stands halfway through a wooden front door, his arms raised as he pulls a thick, textured crimson wool sweater down over his head, stretching the collar. The garment dominates the center of the frame, showing heavy cable-knit patterns and long ribbed sleeves.
